title: Dissapointed
text: Dissapointed. I was so dissapointed when I had put this together. It looked great in the photo and looked great in person. Super easy to put together but when it comes to practicality, it missed the mark. Flimsy shelves were rubbish for holding spices. Sometimes they would fall off on their own. Not happy and do not recommend.
